prompt: Official Campaign Platform for Ernest Trevino for Atascosa County Sheriff

profile.name: Ernest Trevino for Atascosa County Sheriff
profile.hours: Campaign Office: Mon - Sat: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
profile.tagline: Honest Leadership. Safer Communities. Stronger Atascosa County.
profile.description: With 28 years of law enforcement experience, Ernest Trevino is committed to protecting and serving every citizen of Atascosa County with integrity, fairness, professionalism, and respect.

services.title: Priority #1: Protect Our Kids
services.description: Ensure all county officers are cross-trained and ready for active shooters in schools or any location. We will work to protect the future of our children and generations to come.

services.title: Proactive Enforcement & Transparency
services.description: Modernizing law-enforcement practices and fostering interagency cooperation. Rejecting favoritism to ensure equal treatment and open, transparent government for everyone.

services.title: Stronger Community Partnerships
services.description: Restoring and strengthening trust between the Sheriff's Office and the communities we serve. Serving fairly, leading honestly, and protecting everyone.

testimonials.quote: Assisted in the 'Atascosa Ambush' and received the SAPD Medal of Valor, Texas Governor's Medal of Valor, and DPS Director's Award.
testimonials.author: Medal of Valor Recipient

testimonials.quote: Served as an ROP Detective involved in 165 high-risk felony search warrants. Joint work with federal agencies contributed to 1,473 felony suspect arrests.
testimonials.author: Undercover ROP Detective

testimonials.quote: Supervised over 3,200 sworn officers and managed a  million budget environment for the San Antonio Police Department.
testimonials.author: Patrol Division Command
